flashcards.title: DMV Flashcards - Set 1: Mahahalagang Tuntunin
flashcards.description: 15 mahahalagang tanong at sagot sa DMV ng California para sa paghahanda sa driving test (Tagalog at Ingles).

cards.question: Iligal para sa isang taong 21 taong gulang o mas matanda na magmaneho na may konsentrasyon ng alkohol sa dugo (BAC) na ____ o mas mataas.
cards.questionEn: It is illegal for a person 21 years of age or older to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) that is ____ or higher.

cards.question: Dapat mong ipaalam sa DMV sa loob ng 5 araw kung ikaw ay:
cards.answer: nagbenta o naglipat ng iyong sasakyan
cards.questionEn: You must notify DMV within 5 days if you:

cards.question: Naghahanda kang lumiko pakanan. Dapat kang:
cards.answer: mag-senyas sa huling 100 talampakan bago ka lumiko
cards.questionEn: You are getting ready to make a right turn. You should:
cards.answerEn: signal during the last 100 feet before you turn

cards.question: Sa alin sa mga sumusunod na ilaw-trapiko ka dapat laging huminto?
cards.answer: matatag na pulang ilaw, kumukurap na pulang ilaw, at mga patay na ilaw-trapiko
cards.questionEn: For which of the following traffic lights must you always stop your vehicle?
cards.answerEn: solid red lights, flashing red lights, and blacked-out traffic signals

cards.question: Kailan legal na gumamit ng cell phone nang walang hands-free device habang nagmamaneho?
cards.answer: kapag tumatawag para humingi ng tulong sa emergency
cards.questionEn: When is it legal to use a cell phone without a hands-free device while driving?
cards.answerEn: when making a call for emergency assistance

cards.question: Kapag hindi gumagana ang ilaw-trapiko sa isang interseksyon, dapat kang:
cards.answer: huminto nang ganap pagkatapos ay magpatuloy kapag ligtas na
cards.questionEn: When a traffic signal light isn't working at an intersection, you should:
cards.answerEn: come to a complete stop then proceed when it is safe

cards.question: Dapat mong iayos ang iyong rear view at side view mirrors:
cards.questionEn: You should adjust your rear view and side view mirrors:

cards.question: Ang paninigarilyo sa loob ng sasakyan kapag may taong wala pang 18 taong gulang ay:
cards.questionEn: Smoking inside a vehicle when a person younger than 18 years of age is present is:

cards.question: Dapat kang gumawa ng nakasulat na ulat ng aksidente sa trapiko na naganap sa California (SR 1) sa DMV kung ikaw ay:
cards.answer: kasangkot sa isang banggaan at may higit sa $1,000 na pinsala
cards.questionEn: You must make a written report of traffic accident occurring in California (SR 1) to DMV if you:
cards.answerEn: are involved in a collision and there is more than $1,000 in damages

cards.question: Magandang ugali na patuloy na mag-senyas sa huling 100 talampakan bago ka lumiko sa isang interseksyon:
cards.answer: kahit na wala kang nakikitang ibang sasakyan sa paligid
cards.questionEn: It is a good habit to signal continuously during the last 100 feet before you turn at an intersection:
cards.answerEn: even if you do not see any other vehicles around

cards.question: Kapag nagbabahagi ng kalsada sa isang light rail vehicle:
cards.answer: huwag kailanman lumiko sa harap ng papalapit na light rail vehicle
cards.questionEn: When sharing the road with a light rail vehicle:
cards.answerEn: never turn in front of an approaching light rail vehicle

cards.question: Nagmamaneho ka sa gabi sa madilim na kalsada gamit ang high beams. Dapat mong babaan ang iyong ilaw kapag ikaw ay nasa loob ng 500 talampakan mula sa:
cards.answer: isang sasakyang papalapit sa iyo mula sa likuran
cards.questionEn: You are driving at night on a dimly lit street and using high beams. You should dim your lights when you are within 500 feet of:
cards.answerEn: a vehicle approaching you from behind

cards.question: Mag-iwan ng dagdag na espasyo sa harap ng iyong sasakyan kapag sumusunod sa:
cards.questionEn: Allow extra space in front of your vehicle when following a:

cards.question: Kahit alam mong kaya ng iyong sasakyan na liko sa matalim na kurba sa legal na limitasyon ng bilis, dapat ka pa ring magpabagal dahil:
cards.answer: maaaring may nasirang kotse o banggaan sa unahan na hindi mo nakikita
cards.questionEn: Even if you know your vehicle can maneuver a sharp curve at the legal speed limit, you should still slow down because:
cards.answerEn: there may be a stalled car or collision ahead that you can't see

cards.question: Iniparada mo ang iyong kotse sa gilid ng isang patag na two-way na kalsada. Bago ka bumaba ng kotse, dapat kang:
cards.answer: tumingin ng mga kotse o bisikleta sa gilid ng trapiko ng iyong sasakyan
cards.questionEn: You park your car at the curb on a level two-way street. Before getting out of your car, you should:
cards.answerEn: look for cars or bicycles on the traffic side of your vehicle
